mapper.select: select promotion_id, merchant_id, promotion_title, voucher_now_amount, start_time, end_time from merchant_grab_promotion where merchant_id=#{merchantId} order by promotion_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select promotion_id, merchant_id, promotion_title, voucher_now_amount, start_time, end_time from merchant_grab_promotion where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() order by promotion_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select promotion_id, merchant_id, voucher_id, promotion_title, promotion_description, promotion_notice, voucher_origin_amount, voucher_now_amount, start_time, end_time, create_time from merchant_grab_promotion where promotion_id=#{promotionId}
mapper.update: update meal set is_delete=true where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and is_delete=false
update merchant_grab_promotion set voucher_now_amount=voucher_now_amount-1 where promotion_id=#{promotionId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() and voucher_now_amount>0
